user_story: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete so that I can track my progress.

positive.title: Mark a task as complete successfully
steps: Open the task management application
Navigate to the list of tasks
Select a task marked as incomplete
Click on the 'Mark as Complete' button
positive.expected_result: The task is marked as complete and visually updated in the task list with a completion indicator.

negative.title: Attempt to mark a non-existent task as complete
steps: Open the task management application
Navigate to the task list
Try to retrieve a task that does not exist
Attempt to mark the non-existent task as complete
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the task does not exist and the operation cannot be completed.

negative.title: Try to mark a task as complete without permissions
steps: Log in to the task management application as a user without edit permissions
Navigate to the task list
Select a task marked as incomplete
Attempt to click on the 'Mark as Complete' button
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed explaining the lack of permission to complete the task, and no action is taken.

edge.title: Mark a task with special characters in its name as complete
steps: Open the task management application
Navigate to the list of tasks
Select a task with special characters in its name that is marked as incomplete
Click on the 'Mark as Complete' button
edge.expected_result: The task is marked as complete without any issues, and special characters in the name are handled correctly.

edge.title: Mark a task as complete when network connection is unstable
steps: Open the task management application with an unstable network connection
Navigate to the list of tasks
Select a task marked as incomplete
Click on the 'Mark as Complete' button
edge.expected_result: The application retries the operation until successful, or a message is displayed notifying the user of network issues if the task could not be marked as complete.
